about: Public duel spot rules, one table for the server (backend/src/duels/public.ts spotFor) and the phone (game/services/public_duel_spots.gd). seats: four flags in seat order (side 0 seats 0 and 1, side 1 seats 2 and 3), true while the seat is open. wanted: a tapped seat or null. Answers: seat, or reason.

cases.name: alone takes the spot beside a player first
alone beside a player on the other pair
alone with only pair spots takes the first half
alone with one spot left takes it
alone may tap any open ring
party takes the whole open pair
party tapping a ring of the open pair takes that pair
party with spots in different pairs
party picks the first open pair
